request: Add to Flow a command listMine, titled "List my cards", on Cmd+Shift+M (mod+shift+m), whose toast reads "Mine: " and then the refs of the board's cards owned by me (state.me), in board order, separated by ", ". Write it in Lisp, with its key, in the program's flow.lisp.

add./program/flow.lisp/listMine:
(defcommand listMine "Says which of the board's cards are mine." :title "List my cards" :category "Issue"
  []
  (notify (str "Mine: " (join ", " (map (fn [card] (:ref card)) (filter (fn [card] (= (:who card) state.me)) computed.allCards))))))
